suggestions.reasoning: As detailed in TopCV Vietnam (2024), there is a 42% drop in junior 2D banner designer job posts alongside a 68% rise in 'AI Visual Director / UI-UX Lead' roles offering 30-50% higher salaries. Generative diffusion models have automated basic asset generation (OpenAI/UPenn 2023), requiring designers to elevate their skills toward strategic brand direction, design systems governance, and UI/UX architecture.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your strong foundation in visual design from Ho Chi Minh City University of Architecture, combined with your empathetic branding skills and creative intuition, makes you exceptionally well-suited to transition into AI-augmented visual direction and UI/UX. Instead of competing with generative tools on routine banners, you will direct them as a 10x brainstorming accelerator.
transferableSkillsMatch: Client brief interpretation and brand empathy
skillsGap: Advanced AI prompt engineering and generative pipeline control
UI/UX interface prototyping and user flow design
